title: Freya Welcome to Paradise

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: You made it. Welcome to Calypso Island. I hope you find your time here restful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You made it. Welcome to Calypso Island. I hope you find your time here restful.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Do you have something to say to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have something to say to me?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Is this a negotiation now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this a negotiation now?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: You're telling me that legendary DJ Finn Amano is friends with... you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're telling me that legendary DJ Finn Amano is friends with... you?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: You're persistent. Like a new Dolly track that worms its way into your head and won't get out. You have a minute left.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're persistent. Like a new Dolly track that worms its way into your head and won't get out. You have a minute left.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: We're on vacation darling. You should try to relax. Unclench those shoulders. But go ahead. I'll hear you out. But first, did you bring me something lovely? A gift?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're on vacation darling. You should try to relax. Unclench those shoulders. But go ahead. I'll hear you out. But first, did you bring me something lovely? A gift?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Oooohhh. I do like the thrill of a good accident. People pushed to their limits, scrambling to try and find a fix, a way out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oooohhh. I do like the thrill of a good accident. People pushed to their limits, scrambling to try and find a fix, a way out.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Where did you get this?? I thought Finn dove off the deep end and drowned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where did you get this?? I thought Finn dove off the deep end and drowned.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: It's a tool that, when used correctly, can make problems go away. We have a little side business to... Well why give all this away to you? I know who you are you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a tool that, when used correctly, can make problems go away. We have a little side business to... Well why give all this away to you? I know who you are you know?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: In my business it's best to assume everyone knows everything. But never reveal anything, even if you think everyone might already know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In my business it's best to assume everyone knows everything. But never reveal anything, even if you think everyone might already know.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: You think I am not ALREADY helping Edison? Protecting Edison? And his family? What are you saying?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I am not ALREADY helping Edison? Protecting Edison? And his family? What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Of course you can. If you didn't have something to offer me, I wouldn't be letting you stand here in front of me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course you can. If you didn't have something to offer me, I wouldn't be letting you stand here in front of me.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Serious accusations against a company I am only tangentially involved with. And I have never heard of a "Network."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Serious accusations against a company I am only tangentially involved with. And I have never heard of a "Network."

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: You have no evidence, and only a vague understanding of the reality of what's happening. And no understanding of the danger you are in, apparently.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have no evidence, and only a vague understanding of the reality of what's happening. And no understanding of the danger you are in, apparently.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Almost certainly a bluff. But a bold one. Let's skip past this and get to your offer. What can you give me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Almost certainly a bluff. But a bold one. Let's skip past this and get to your offer. What can you give me?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Tell me who she is and why she would be of interest?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me who she is and why she would be of interest?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: If she's as dangerous as you say, and so am I, what do YOU think you can bring to the table. No offence, but you're a... minnow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If she's as dangerous as you say, and so am I, what do YOU think you can bring to the table. No offence, but you're a... minnow.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: Yes... Yes, perhaps someone like you can help. But Mica has protections. Defenses. How can YOU circumvent her security?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... Yes, perhaps someone like you can help. But Mica has protections. Defenses. How can YOU circumvent her security?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: That's a better idea than you could know. I control the environment here. I can expose her and cut her off from her protections. And I suppose I have nothing to lose... but how do you know YOU can trust ME?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a better idea than you could know. I control the environment here. I can expose her and cut her off from her protections. And I suppose I have nothing to lose... but how do you know YOU can trust ME?

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: It's just like when I bought my first resort and it almost went tits up. Wild times. Really speaks to a person's character if they make it through. Alright... I'll give you two minutes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's just like when I bought my first resort and it almost went tits up. Wild times. Really speaks to a person's character if they make it through. Alright... I'll give you two minutes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It wasn't easy to see you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It wasn't easy to see you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It wasn't easy to see you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It wasn't easy to see you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. I have a proposal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I have a proposal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. I have a proposal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. I have a proposal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's an opportunity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's an opportunity.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's an opportunity.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's an opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Legendary is a bit of a stretch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Legendary is a bit of a stretch.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Legendary is a bit of a stretch.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Legendary is a bit of a stretch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm full of surprises.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm full of surprises.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm full of surprises.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm full of surprises.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you heard of a seasoning called Shimmer Sage?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you heard of a seasoning called Shimmer Sage?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you heard of a seasoning called Shimmer Sage?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you heard of a seasoning called Shimmer Sage?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's a... friend of mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's a... friend of mine.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's a... friend of mine.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's a... friend of mine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How about a piece of bone from an accident on the Oil Rig?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about a piece of bone from an accident on the Oil Rig?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How about a piece of bone from an accident on the Oil Rig?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How about a piece of bone from an accident on the Oil Rig?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How about the sheet music for an unreleased Finn Amano track?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about the sheet music for an unreleased Finn Amano track?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How about the sheet music for an unreleased Finn Amano track?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How about the sheet music for an unreleased Finn Amano track?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Edison doesn't know I'm here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison doesn't know I'm here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Edison doesn't know I'm here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Edison doesn't know I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm here to help Edison.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm here to help Edison.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm here to help Edison.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm here to help Edison.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's do business here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's do business here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let's do business here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let's do business here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know what you really are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know what you really are.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I know what you really are.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I know what you really are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can help you Freya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can help you Freya.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can help you Freya.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can help you Freya.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Conland Containers and The Network are exploiting these kids.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Conland Containers and The Network are exploiting these kids.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Conland Containers and The Network are exploiting these kids.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Conland Containers and The Network are exploiting these kids.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Come on Freya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on Freya.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Come on Freya.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Come on Freya.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I bet we could find traces of the tainted Shimmer Sage in your warehouses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I bet we could find traces of the tainted Shimmer Sage in your warehouses.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I bet we could find traces of the tainted Shimmer Sage in your warehouses.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I bet we could find traces of the tainted Shimmer Sage in your warehouses.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: That's what we're doing here. When the business is over, I'll ask you to leave.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what we're doing here. When the business is over, I'll ask you to leave.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: And who knows who YOU are? And, more importantly, who knows you're here? And would miss you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And who knows who YOU are? And, more importantly, who knows you're here? And would miss you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have the records of Edison's niece, and I know they were erased.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have the records of Edison's niece, and I know they were erased.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have the records of Edison's niece, and I know they were erased.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have the records of Edison's niece, and I know they were erased.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Edison is a witness to everything that happened, and he is in hiding already.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison is a witness to everything that happened, and he is in hiding already.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Edison is a witness to everything that happened, and he is in hiding already.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Edison is a witness to everything that happened, and he is in hiding already.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mica Rain.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mica Rain.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Come on, you know she's your enemy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Come on, you know she's your enemy.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's dangerous.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm smart.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm smart.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm smart.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I will lure her here where she's exposed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will lure her here where she's exposed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I will lure her here where she's exposed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I will lure her here where she's exposed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have evidence - the traces of Shimmer Sage, the erased records, Edison as a witness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have evidence - the traces of Shimmer Sage, the erased records, Edison as a witness.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have evidence - the traces of Shimmer Sage, the erased records, Edison as a witness.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have evidence - the traces of Shimmer Sage, the erased records, Edison as a witness.

nodes.speaker: Freya Portlet
nodes.text: You've got guts, I'll give you that. More than Edison. Alright. Let's see where this goes. Bring Mica here. Then I'll give you what you want.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've got guts, I'll give you that. More than Edison. Alright. Let's see where this goes. Bring Mica here. Then I'll give you what you want.

nodes.text: If I'm crazy enough to do all this, what else could I do if you betrayed me?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I'm crazy enough to do all this, what else could I do if you betrayed me?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's a deal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's a deal.

nodes.text: It's nice to finally meet you.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's nice to finally meet you.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: We have business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We have business.

nodes.speaker: Player

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm here to free Edison's niece.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm here to free Edison's niece.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm here to free Edison's niece.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're part of The Network and the one behind all of these schemes.
